title: Business English Conversation 29:  Flexible Schedule
content: 1. to work flexible hours: to have more freedom in choosing the hours that one works - I love my company because I can work flexible hours. - She works flexible hours. She usually comes in at 11 and goes home at 7. 2. to be in accounting: to work in the accounting department - I am in accounting. - She is in accounting. 3. to work regular business hours: to work normal hours for the country one works in (in America this usually 9 am to 5 pm or 9 am to 6 pm) - We don't work flexible hours. We work regular business hours. - Salesman usually can't work flexible hours. They have to deal with clients and customers, so they must work regular business hours.
